title: The Meadow Express
description: Approach the rural station, ride moving cargo through the railway, and race out into open country. Extreme edition: tenfold machinery, spike-lined catches and compressed timing.

identity.scope: Decoration reference route; not a final five-minute stage

rooms.name: The quiet meadow
rooms.lesson: Find the station beyond the fences. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The rural platform
rooms.lesson: Duck under the station beams. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: Cargo in motion
rooms.lesson: Board the cargo truck · watch its rail. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: Beside the rails
rooms.lesson: Transfer between the loading roofs. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.

rooms.name: The country express
rooms.lesson: Carry the tailwind into the final fields. Read the latch; dash through as the gate opens.
